label: Under classical logic, the SAME fixed selected conjunction is contingent exactly when it is…
paraphrase: Under classical logic, the SAME fixed selected conjunction is contingent exactly when it is actually true and at least one selected fact member is contingent. This is a universally parameterized logical equivalence, not an assertion of joint truth, a contingent member or actual contingency. It does not make every member contingent or identify any member as a choice, individual bearer, cause, necessary ingredient or sufficient explanation.
